product_one_liner.value: Rivo is an automated cash-management service for U.S. consumers that moves eligible idle cash from an existing checking account into short-term U.S. Treasury bills and brings it back around bills and spending needs.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes cash automation on its homepage and provides further product and safety details in its FAQ.

pricing_page.notes: The accessible official homepage and site links show no public pricing page or pricing link; pricing was not listed there.

named_customers.notes: This is a consumer cash-management product, not the separate Shopify retention business also named Rivo. No customer case-study or logo wall for this rivofi.com company was found.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 2–10 employees, which is outside the permitted bands; other sources give a small headcount but do not substantiate one of the required bands.

hq_location.notes: The company LinkedIn profile gives San Francisco, CA as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Company LinkedIn lists 2025; the founder profile identifies his Rivo role beginning in 2025.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows consumer financial education, product explanations, comparisons and company news; it does not show two engineer-authored posts describing product architecture, infrastructure, ML, data systems, incidents or open source.

public_docs.notes: The site provides a consumer FAQ, but no linked public product documentation, developer portal or help center with several product-documentation articles was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Search surfaced a separate Rivo company careers page, so current openings cannot safely be attributed to rivofi.com.

model_provider.notes: The FAQ describes AI functionality but does not identify a model or model provider; the privacy page could not be accessed for provider details, and no public model attribution was found.

compliance_certs.notes: The company FAQ states that Rivo is SOC 2 compliant.

last_funding.notes: The August 2026 seed was $2.7 million; Rivo reported total funding of $3.1 million including that round.

raised_18mo.notes: The company announced its $2.7 million seed round and $3.1 million total funding in August/September 2026, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A jobs page for a different Rivo business appeared in search. No official careers or job board was verified for rivofi.com, so the observed postings cannot establish this company's hiring status.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 7, 2026 announcement says Rivo came out of beta and launched publicly, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company site does not provide a verifiable full team page or dated leadership join/departure information. The founder profile alone does not establish whether any C-level/VP transition occurred.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No company job posts, developer documentation or integrations page naming a CRM or sales/marketing system could be verified.
